requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion of the device or optical component is visible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water; this test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, and the device shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector 10 min at 50 °C ± 5 °C 20 mm below surface, repeat inverted, then immerse at 25 °C ± 5 °C; verify conditions recorded.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: After the water immersion test, visually inspect the reflecting surface; pass if no water is present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: After lightly shaking off excess water, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check compliance with its criteria.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB, as an alternative test procedure of resistance to water penetration and at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust test shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows the moisture test and dust exposure test were performed per Annex 6 Part 3 when the alternative procedure was requested.

requirements.text: During the moisture test, the precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
requirements.test_case: Verify the collector measurement recorded in the test report is within 2.5 to 4.1 mm/min.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test set-up: all drain holes/openings are unobstructed and any drain wicks are fitted in the device.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the recorded platform rotational speed is between 3.5 and 4.5 min-1.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF during the water spray test.
requirements.test_case: Check the test log shows the grouped rear position, stop and reversing lamps operated at design voltage in 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycles.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test log shows 12 hours of water spray exposure comprising 12 cycles.

requirements.text: After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test log records a 1 hour drain period with spray and rotation off and cabinet door closed.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the interior of the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the device interior after draining, including tapping and tilting; pass if no standing pool of water forms.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1; compare with initial RI and record.

requirements.text: The test dust used for the dust exposure test shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report identifies the dust as ASTM C 150-84 fine powdered cement.

requirements.text: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall and the test dust shall be agitated by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, the dust being allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test log: device ≥150 mm from walls, agitation of 2-15 s every 15 min over 5 hours.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 and verify the result meets that paragraph's criterion.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the corrosion test per ISO 9227:2017 and Annex 6 Part 4; verify the photometric and colorimetric characteristics remain within the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: After the saline mist test, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear face protection for deterioration.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the rear lamp with integrated retro-reflector, stripped of removable parts, to 2 x 24 h saline mist separated by a 2 h drying interval and check test records.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify the salt spray chamber runs at 35 °C ± 2 °C with a 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with ≤0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency is visible.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively, the surface being cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist before measuring.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning of salt deposits, measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if within Table 9 / Table 10 limits.

requirements.text: For mirror-backed moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB with an accessible rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Check test records that the rear face was brushed with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: After having brushed the rear face of a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min, remove and let dry; verify in test records.

requirements.text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side of the mirror-backed retro-reflective device shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear face was re-brushed with the same hard nylon brush after evaporation.

requirements.text: The RI of the mirror-backed retro-reflective device shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.test_case: Cover the rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if the values meet the requirements of the Regulation.

requirements.text: For resistance to weathering, the samples of retro-reflective devices shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Verify the accelerated weathering report shows 500 h exposure per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with Table A6-1 parameters (cycle 1 TM1 or cycle 4 TM2).

requirements.text: For resistance to fuels, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied to the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms that a 70 % n-heptane / 30 % toluol mixture was used for the fuel resistance test of the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: After about five minutes from wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the wiped surface after about 5 minutes; pass if no apparent surface changes other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: For resistance to fuels, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the retro-reflector outer and illuminating surfaces lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture and record the procedure.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil to test resistance to lubricating oils.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface of a moulded PMMA retro-reflector sample with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and check that the procedure was applied as specified.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil resistance test, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the coefficient of luminous intensity (RI) after the oil test per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. Pass if the values meet the criteria of that paragraph.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes of exposure to the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the surface and check by inspection that no oil residue remains before measurement.

requirements.text: The approval number on the retro-reflective device must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and check that the approval number is placed close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device must face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and check that the approval number digits are oriented the same way as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and check that the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is diametrically opposite the approval number.
